unioncorp-docs-upload-theme.png: WordPress Add Themes screen with the Upload Theme panel open, showing a Choose File button and an Install Now button.
unioncorp-docs-activation.mp4: Screen recording: on Appearance, Themes, Activate is clicked on Unioncorp; the Pages list then shows About, Blog, Case studies, Contact, Home, Pricing and Services; the finished home page opens and scrolls down.
unioncorp-docs-activation-poster.jpg: The Themes screen with Unioncorp installed and not yet active.
unioncorp-docs-pages-created.png: The Pages screen straight after activating Unioncorp: About, Blog (Posts Page), Case studies, Contact, Home (Front Page), Pricing and Services, plus WordPress's Privacy Policy and Sample Page.
unioncorp-docs-front-page-map.jpg: The Unioncorp home page from top to bottom in two columns, each part tagged with a number, its name and whether it is a section pattern or a template part: header, hero, about, services, why us, case studies, statistics, team, testimonials, latest posts, call to action and footer.
unioncorp-docs-edit-figure.gif: Animation: in the block editor a statistic reading 9,200 is clicked, selected and retyped as 12,500, and the Save button is highlighted.
unioncorp-docs-list-view.jpg: The block editor with List View open on the left, the services section expanded and selected, its eight service cards on the canvas and its settings on the right.
unioncorp-docs-pattern-inserter.jpg: The block inserter's Patterns tab with Unioncorp: sections open, showing previews of the latest posts, case studies, contact and statistics sections.
unioncorp-docs-change-icon.gif: Animation: a service card's icon tile is selected, Advanced settings are opened, and in Additional CSS class(es) the name calculator is replaced with briefcase; the tile's icon changes to a briefcase.
unioncorp-docs-icons.png: The seventeen Unioncorp icons in blue tiles, each labelled with its name: alert-triangle, award, briefcase, building-bank, calculator, chart-line, clock, device-desktop-analytics, heart-handshake, mail, map-pin, phone, pig-money, quote, receipt-tax, shield-check and users.
unioncorp-docs-scroll-tour.mp4: Screen recording of the Unioncorp home page scrolling from top to bottom: sections fade in as they arrive and the statistics count up to 60, 9,200, 5,800 and 100.
unioncorp-docs-scroll-tour-poster.jpg: The top of the Unioncorp home page: the header and a hero photograph headed We're always here to give financial help.
unioncorp-docs-video-popup.gif: Animation: the Watch the video button in the Why us section is highlighted and clicked, a video opens in a window over the page and plays, and the window closes again.
unioncorp-docs-contact.jpg: The Contact page's contact section: address, email and phone on the left, and on the right the enquiry form with Your name, Email address, Phone number, Company and How can we help? fields and a Request a consultation button.
unioncorp-docs-template-parts.jpg: Appearance, Editor, Patterns, All template parts: previews of the Footer, Header and Sidebar template parts.
unioncorp-docs-edit-header.jpg: The Header template part open in the Site Editor: a top bar with phone number, opening hours and social icons, and below it a grey logo placeholder, the site title, the navigation and a Get started button.
unioncorp-docs-navigation.jpg: Appearance, Editor, Navigation with the Primary menu open, listing Home, About, Services, Case studies, Pricing, Blog and Contact.
unioncorp-docs-styles.jpg: Appearance, Editor, Styles: the Styles panel with Browse styles, Typography, Colors, Background, Shadows and Layout, beside a preview of the home page.
unioncorp-docs-palettes.gif: Animation: clicking through Browse styles colour variations; the preview's about section turns from blue to green, plum, teal, then the dark Midnight and Graphite palettes, and back.
unioncorp-docs-browse-styles.jpg: Browse styles: eight colour variations shown as swatch rows, and six typography variations shown as Aa tiles.
unioncorp-docs-dark-mode.gif: Animation: the moon button in the top bar is highlighted and clicked, the page turns dark, scrolls to show dark cards, and is clicked back to light.
unioncorp-docs-dark-mode.jpg: The same part of the home page side by side in light mode and in dark mode.
unioncorp-docs-template-choice.jpg: The Choose a template window for a page, offering Page without title and Page with sidebar with a preview of each.
